rationale: The original thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA ($55.42) acting as resistance, but price has reclaimed this level and held above it across the last three 1-minute candles even as the broader market weakened further (SPY down to -1.38%). With the ask at $55.53 and a 10.8 bps spread, the trade is steps away from the $55.55 invalidation level, making an immediate exit prudent rather than waiting for a stop-out. Flipping to long is not justified because the stock remains heavily pressured below session VWAP ($56.51) in a strong risk-off tape.
